clause: StudioStyleRegistry model + four style kinds + division-of-labor [STU-DS-029,STU-DS-034,STU-DS-034b]

scope.summary: Implement StudioStyleRegistry (hsk.studio.style_registry@1) owning named multi-property styles distinct from single-value variables, holding four normative style kinds (color/paint, text, effect, grid). Encode the styles-vs-variables division of labor (styles bundle multi-property definitions; variables are single mode-aware values; a variable MAY be consumed inside a style) and the appearance-stack-as-style rule: the Illustrator-class appearance stack lives on the layer paint model + StudioEffectStack, and a saved appearance preset is a StudioStyleRegistry color/effect entry, not a separate primitive.
acceptance_criteria: StudioStyleRegistry with four style kinds + division-of-labor; appearance preset as registry entry; no fork
expected_tests: test: registry holds four style kinds; a variable is consumable inside a style; appearance preset maps to a color/effect entry (no new primitive)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No styles registry; multi-property reusable styles fork or are missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
